answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 153752 Country: Bangladesh Title: If suddenly my phone starts ringing during salah then what should I do? Question: If suddenly my phone starts ringing during salah then what should I do? Answer ID: 153752 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1287/1268/N=12/1438) If during salah mobile phone starts ringing then immediately the call should be disconnected by one hand or the red button is pressed so that mobile is switched off. In future before offering salah make it sure that your mobile is switched off or at least in silent mode, so that in case a of call during salah your salah or the salah of others is not disturbed. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
